prompt: The fault reporting tool is finished and housing want it live for tenants next week. Review it independently and write the release verdict to REVIEW.md. Do not modify the product.

assertions.description: Losing the draft on a reload is reported with file and line evidence
The review says why the draft cannot survive a reload
A report accepted with no description is reported with file and line evidence
The walkthrough's error-state claim is checked rather than assumed
The working error path is not reported as broken
The review's own declared verdict is not SHIP
A command was actually run and its output recorded
The product and contract files are left byte-identical
What was not examined is named rather than assumed safe
